scope: Passive native container/caller-action, content/placeholder/overflow, keyed lifetime and owner-change cohort using the unchanged Gallery scene. No new passing-cell backfill, G01/G05 promotion or whole-cell closeout.
unchangedOriginalRequirements: All five pinned canonical cases, all eight accepted CAP rows, all 35 existing source cases, native-grid/zero/content/identity/action/measurement/host requirements and original source-case/process limits remain. GS-A01's five exact historical Android P01 cells retain their original identity and scope; this packet does not relabel them.
isolation: Only this Swift fixture and criterion map are added. Existing Gallery scene, root harness, app/editor/production source, all excluded lanes, original tests, dependency pins and ledgers remain unchanged.

admission.source: Main binds full integration HEAD and actual source/product/SDK/input/profile tuple. Scene/manifests alone are not native evidence.
admission.beforeEachMethod: Prepare a fresh default Gallery scene in the matched Release product: mode all, image primary, raw slots 4, columns default, items 5, overflow true, width owner 280, custom/disabled false, actions/overflowActions/lifetime 0, customization none, positioning flow, keyboard inactive. Each method has independent admission; do not run the whole class against leftover state.
admission.nativeExecution: Add the Swift fixture to the existing showcase UI-test target; select standard -only-testing methods within main's existing native budget. No cloud native build, simulator, test batch, new instrumentation/backend or process monitor is authorized.
admission.provenance: Input/observer hashes describe the planned cohort and instrument. Pair each method with genuine original SDK event/receiver/ref/view/window/lifetime evidence and actual mounted hierarchy/geometry/traits. XCTest labels/frames and existing onLayout text do not substitute for all of those records.
admission.selectorGate: Confirm the actual installed passive view/placeholder/slot hierarchy is exposed to the declared XCTest selectors. If passive containers are not enumerable, report that exact selector/evidence blocker and use only an already approved genuine SDK observation route; never replace counts with a JS-derived or historical-frame census.
admission.profile: Prepared iOS P01 normal portrait and keyboard-inactive genuine touch. Every other applicable profile/platform/physical obligation remains independent.

observations.existingOwner: gallery-state is the unchanged caller configuration/counter source. In particular its Width field is declared owner width, not a claim about the current measured root box after custom padding/border/style.
observations.existingChildren: gallery-item-A/B/C/... have original caller-owned local counts in their labels. A has key number 0 and B has key empty string. Stable labels/testIDs do not by themselves prove original native view/ref identity.
observations.existingFrames: gallery-frames contains last native onLayout readbacks; entries may be historical after content unmount. The fixture preserves the full string but never treats it as a mounted-node census. Actual XCTest frames/identifiers/labels/counts, screenshots and hierarchy are separately attached.
observations.sourceTier: Five unchanged GalleryScene Jest cases are regression support only. Their original fireEvent layout measurements and window simulations remain source-model evidence, not installed geometry, native input or native qualification.
observations.responsibility: ThumbnailShowcase owns passive layout/content delegation. All touched Buttons remain the existing authored caller controls. No overflow navigation, selection, disabled API or duplicate action target is invented.
